stories.title: Xi chega a Washington nesta terça-feira para encontro com Trump com IA e Taiwan no radar

en.title: Xi arrives in Washington this Tuesday for meeting with Trump with AI and Taiwan on the agenda
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in the United States for a meeting with President Donald Trump at the White House. Xi is expected to pressure Trump to suspend arms sales to Taiwan according to a 1982 joint declaration.

stories.title: O que se sabe sobre acidente de helicóptero que matou o cantor Rick e outras 4 pessoas em SC

en.title: What is known about the helicopter accident that killed singer Rick and 4 others in SC
en.summary: Singer Rick from the Rick and Renner duo died in a helicopter crash in Santa Catarina. The wreckage and bodies of five men aboard were found on Tuesday.

stories.title: Trump se reúne com Delcy Rodríguez pela primeira vez após captura de Maduro

en.title: Trump meets with Delcy Rodríguez for the first time after capture of Maduro
en.summary: President Trump held a meeting with Delcy Rodríguez following the capture of Maduro.

stories.title: Trump se encontra com líder da Venezuela pela primeira vez desde captura de Maduro

en.title: Trump meets with Venezuelan leader for the first time since capture of Maduro
en.summary: President Donald Trump met with interim Venezuelan leader Delcy Rodríguez at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday in their first in-person meeting.

stories.title: Mega-Sena acumula para R$ 38 milhões; confira os números sorteados

en.title: Mega-Sena accumulates to R$ 38 million; check the drawn numbers
en.summary: No winners matched all six numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3,061 on Tuesday. The prize rolled over to an estimated R$ 38 million for the next drawing, with 39 players matching five numbers and 2,148 matching four numbers.

stories.title: Resultado da Quina 7124: confira as dezenas sorteadas nesta terça-feira (22)

en.title: Quina 7124 result: check the numbers drawn on Tuesday (22)
en.summary: The Quina lottery draw 7124 took place on Tuesday with an estimated prize of R$ 2 million.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3061: confira as dezenas sorteadas nesta terça-feira (22)

en.title: Mega-Sena 3061 result: check the numbers drawn on Tuesday (22)
en.summary: Mega-Sena draw 3,061 took place on Tuesday at the Espaço da Sorte in São Paulo with an estimated prize of R$ 32 million.

stories.title: Sócio do cantor Rick foi convidado para voo em helicóptero que caiu em SC, mas preferiu ir de carro

en.title: Singer Rick's partner was invited to helicopter flight that crashed in SC, but preferred to travel by car
en.summary: A business partner of singer Rick was invited to board the helicopter that crashed in Santa Catarina but chose to travel by car instead.

stories.title: Enxaqueca refratária: entenda a condição neurológica que levou Michelle Bolsonaro ao hospital

en.title: Refractory migraine: understand the neurological condition that led Michelle Bolsonaro to the hospital
en.summary: Michelle Bolsonaro was hospitalized due to refractory migraine, a neurological condition characterized by migraines resistant to standard treatments.

stories.title: Com enxaqueca, Michelle Bolsonaro é internada em Brasília sem previsão de alta

en.title: With migraine, Michelle Bolsonaro is hospitalized in Brasília with no discharge date set
en.summary: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro was admitted to Hospital DF Star in Brasília on Tuesday with a migraine condition, with no estimated discharge date provided.

stories.title: Juiz federal deu votos pró-Master 6 meses antes de contrato milionário de sua esposa com banco, diz jornal

en.title: Federal judge cast votes favoring Master 6 months before his wife's million-dollar bank contract, newspaper says
en.summary: A federal judge voted favorably for Banco Master in legal proceedings related to a power plant, six months before his wife allegedly signed a major contract with the bank's owner.

stories.title: Desembargador beneficiou Master 6 meses antes de sua mulher fechar contrato de R$ 427 mi com Vorcaro

en.title: Appeals court judge benefited Master 6 months before his wife closed R$ 427 million contract with Vorcaro
en.summary: An appeals court judge voted in favor of Banco Master in legal matters before his wife subsequently signed a R$ 427 million contract with the bank's owner Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Mensagens de Vorcaro mostram advogado articulando aproximação de banqueiro com governo Lula, diz O Globo

en.title: Messages from Vorcaro show lawyer articulating banker's approach to Lula government, says O Globo
en.summary: Federal Police extracted messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showing lawyer Walfrido Warde facilitated contact between a banker and President Lula, with conversations spanning from before their December 2024 meeting through January 2025.

stories.title: Instabilidade em GPS do Embraer E2 afetou mais de 70 voos da Azul, dizem fontes

en.title: GPS instability in Embraer E2 affected more than 70 Azul flights, sources say
en.summary: A global GPS system instability in Embraer E2 aircraft forced Brazilian airline Azul to cancel over 70 flights, affecting approximately 15,000 passengers. Competitors Gol and Latam have ordered the aircraft but have not yet begun operations.

stories.title: Microsoft concederá a agência governamental acesso direto a sistema de computação quântica nos EUA

en.title: Microsoft will grant U.S. government agency direct access to quantum computing system
en.summary: Microsoft announced it will provide the U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency direct access to its latest quantum computing hardware at a new research center established in Maryland.

stories.title: Azul aponta instabilidade no sistema de GPS do Embraer E2 e faz ajuste de malha

en.title: Azul points to GPS system instability in Embraer E2 and adjusts flight schedule
en.summary: Azul announced a global GPS system instability is affecting its Embraer E2 fleet operations, prompting the airline to implement operational measures that may result in flight schedule adjustments. Customers are advised to verify reservation status before traveling to airports.

stories.title: Na reta final para o 1º turno, Flávio explora endividamento e Lula, o combate às bets

en.title: In the final stretch for the 1st round, Flávio explores indebtedness and Lula, the fight against betting
en.summary: The two leading presidential candidates, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, used television time to criticize opponents and present proposals. Flávio argued that Lula avoids discussing population indebtedness, while Lula emphasized his commitment to eliminating betting houses and linked his opponent to this sector.
